lessons.title: Variables and data types
lessons.content: Python names refer to values. Use type() to inspect a value and choose a collection that matches the data.

lessons.title: Control flow
lessons.content: Conditions choose a path; loops repeat work. Keep loop bodies small and test boundary cases.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.content: A function names a unit of work. Prefer explicit parameters, a useful return value, and one clear responsibility.
